instruction: Add generalized_petersen_graph(n, k, *, create_using=None) to networkx's small graph generators (networkx/generators/small.py, available as nx.generalized_petersen_graph): the generalized Petersen graph GP(n, k), with an outer cycle on nodes 0..n-1 (edges i - (i+1) mod n), spokes i - n+i, and inner edges n+i - n+((i+k) mod n). It needs n >= 3 and 1 <= k <= n/2 (k = n/2 is allowed), else raises NetworkXError. create_using works as for the other small graphs (a MultiGraph gets the same edges), but a directed graph type raises NetworkXError with a message starting 'Directed Graph not supported'. Known cases: GP(5, 2) is the Petersen graph, GP(10, 3) the Desargues graph, GP(8, 3) the Moebius-Kantor graph and GP(10, 2) the dodecahedron; GP(10, 4) has 20 nodes, 30 edges, every degree 3, diameter 4 and radius 4. Add tests.
